# Aggregator submissions

Reference drafts for listing the **Tech Debt MCP** Claude Code plugin on community marketplaces. These are not auto-submitted — a maintainer copies the relevant draft into the aggregator's submission flow (web form, PR to their registry repo, etc.).

Tracked in-repo so we can update them in lockstep with `plugin.json` / `marketplace.json` whenever the plugin's surface changes.

| File | Target |
|------|--------|
| `claudemarketplaces.md` | https://claudemarketplaces.com |
| `buildwithclaude.md` | https://buildwithclaude.com |
| `issue-177-dogfood-notes.md` | Comment template for GitHub issue [#177](https://github.com/PierreJanineh/TechDebtMCP/issues/177), used to record dogfood friction at the end of each release cycle |
